UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no class, or a class this enum does not model.

CONTROLLED.description: A controlled airspace volume not otherwise classified below.

RESTRICTED.description: Restricted area: entry restricted per published conditions.

DANGER.description: Danger area: activities hazardous to flight may exist.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No datum stated. A consumer MUST refuse a boundary whose value is present but whose datum is UNSPECIFIED rather than guess a reference.

FLIGHT_LEVEL.description: Flight level: the value is the flight level number (hundreds of feet on the standard atmosphere), not metres.

SURFACE.description: The ground or water surface itself; the boundary value is NaN.

UNLIMITED.description: No upper limit; the boundary value is NaN. A datum member, never a sentinel altitude.

AVLProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one airspace volume.

Required on every record: a redistributed volume whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. Dataset identity is DATA;
the standard names no dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the aeronautical dataset
this volume was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset
registry. Never a display name and never a URL.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
volume was decoded from — the edition boundary (e.g. an AIRAC cycle
effective date), not the fetch.

DATASET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when the publisher
distributes one.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description:
The source dataset's own identifier for this volume, verbatim. The
join key back to the source; never re-minted by the publisher.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description: RFC 3339 UTC date the source last modified this volume, as it states.

ID.description:
Publisher-stable identifier for this volume record. Never the source's
own identifier, which rides verbatim in SOURCE.NATIVE_ID.

DESIGNATOR.description: Published designator of the volume, verbatim (e.g. an area designator).

NAME.description: Published display name of the volume, verbatim.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no class, or a class this enum does not model.

CONTROLLED.description: A controlled airspace volume not otherwise classified below.

RESTRICTED.description: Restricted area: entry restricted per published conditions.

DANGER.description: Danger area: activities hazardous to flight may exist.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

FLOOR_VALUE.description:
Lower vertical limit, metres in FLOOR_DATUM (flight-level number when
FLOOR_DATUM is FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when SURFACE). NaN when unpublished.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No datum stated. A consumer MUST refuse a boundary whose value is present but whose datum is UNSPECIFIED rather than guess a reference.

FLIGHT_LEVEL.description: Flight level: the value is the flight level number (hundreds of feet on the standard atmosphere), not metres.

SURFACE.description: The ground or water surface itself; the boundary value is NaN.

UNLIMITED.description: No upper limit; the boundary value is NaN. A datum member, never a sentinel altitude.

CEILING_VALUE.description:
Upper vertical limit, metres in CEILING_DATUM (flight-level number
when FLIGHT_LEVEL; NaN when UNLIMITED). NaN when unpublished.

UNSPECIFIED.description: No datum stated. A consumer MUST refuse a boundary whose value is present but whose datum is UNSPECIFIED rather than guess a reference.

FLIGHT_LEVEL.description: Flight level: the value is the flight level number (hundreds of feet on the standard atmosphere), not metres.

SURFACE.description: The ground or water surface itself; the boundary value is NaN.

UNLIMITED.description: No upper limit; the boundary value is NaN. A datum member, never a sentinel altitude.

EFFECTIVE_FROM.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume becomes effective.

EFFECTIVE_TO.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant this volume ceases. Absent for
a volume with no published end.

TIME_OF_ACTIVITY.description:
Activity schedule verbatim as the source publishes it (NOTAM-style
text). Never parsed into structure by the publisher: schedule grammar
is source-specific and coercion would invent activations.

VERTEX_LATITUDE_DEG.description:
Vertex latitudes, geodetic degrees in [-90, 90]. Same length as
VERTEX_LONGITUDE_DEG.

RING_OFFSETS.description: Ring start indexes; RING_COUNT + 1 entries, last equals vertex count.

RING_POLYGON_INDEXES.description:
Polygon each ring belongs to. One entry per ring, so its length is
RING_OFFSETS length - 1.

RING_ROLES.description:
Role of each ring. One entry per ring, so its length is RING_OFFSETS
length - 1.

POLYGON_COUNT.description:
Number of polygons; equals max(RING_POLYGON_INDEXES) + 1, published so
an empty geometry is distinguishable from an unpopulated record.

ARC_DENSIFIED.description:
The source's arc or circle boundary segments were densified into the
vertices above by the ingest.

DENSIFICATION_TOLERANCE_M.description:
Maximum deviation, metres, between a densified chord and the published
arc. Required knowledge when ARC_DENSIFIED; NaN otherwise.
